data.description: Brand New | Pool View | Close to Mall and Park
data.display_address: Hills Park, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience modern living in this brand-new 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in Hills Park. Designed with comfort and style in mind, this spacious unit offers a bright open-plan layout, contemporary finishes, and large windows that fill the home with natural light while providing a relaxing pool view.

The master bedroom features an en-suite bathroom and built-in wardrobes, while the second bedroom is generously sized and ideal for family members or guests. The modern kitchen comes with high-quality fittings and ample storage space, seamlessly flowing into the living and dining area—perfect for both relaxing and entertaining.

Located in a prime community setting, the property is just a short walk from the mall and park, offering convenience and lifestyle at your doorstep. Residents can enjoy premium amenities including a swimming pool, landscaped areas, and dedicated parking.

An ideal choice for families or investors looking for a stylish home in a vibrant and well-connected neighborhood.
